headline: Sales rebound sequentially as merger costs squeeze profit
summary_short: Axalta's Q2 2026 revenue rose to $1,346M, up 3.1% y/y and 7.3% q/q, while net income fell to $89M (-18.3% y/y) as $31M of AkzoNobel merger-related costs weighed on results.
summary_long: Net sales rose 3.1% y/y and 7.3% q/q to $1,346M, driven by favorable FX translation and contributions from recent Performance Coatings acquisitions, partially offset by lower North America volumes. Gross margin expanded 130bp q/q to 34.5% but fell 50bp y/y. Operating income rose 14.4% q/q but fell 13.5% y/y to $167M as other operating charges jumped to $42M, including $31M of merger and acquisition costs tied to the proposed AkzoNobel combination (shareholder vote August 5, 2026; expected close late 2026/early 2027). Net income fell 18.3% y/y to $89M; diluted EPS was $0.41. The company prepaid $125M of 2029 Term Loans; cash fell to $633M from $657M at year-end. No new guidance was issued in this filing.
